ex: Can I sublet my room for the summer?
exzh: 我暑假可以把房間轉租出去嗎?
note: 多數租約要房東書面同意才能轉租

ex: My roommate works nights, so it's pretty quiet during the day.
exzh: 我室友上夜班,所以白天很安靜。

ex: A studio downtown runs about $2,000 a month.
exzh: 市中心一間套房月租大約兩千美元。
note: studio 沒獨立臥室;1BR 才有一間臥室

ex: We're renting one side of a duplex near campus.
exzh: 我們在學校附近租了雙併住宅的其中一邊。
note: 一棟分兩戶,各有獨立出入口

ex: They just bought a townhouse with a small backyard.
exzh: 他們剛買了一間有小後院的連棟透天。

ex: Without a US credit history, you may need a cosigner.
exzh: 沒有美國信用紀錄的話,你可能需要保證人。
note: 沒信用紀錄常被要求;也可改付較多押金

ex: Since you're moving in on the 20th, your first month will be prorated.
exzh: 你20號入住,所以第一個月租金按天數算。
note: 月中入住,第一個月只付剩餘天數

ex: The HOA fees are $350 a month, but they cover the pool.
exzh: 管委會費一個月350美元,但包含游泳池。
note: Homeowners Association;連草多長都管

ex: We'll send you a renewal offer 60 days before your lease ends.
exzh: 租約到期前60天我們會寄續約方案給你。
note: 續約常漲租,可以談

ex: I'll call a handyman to fix the fence.
exzh: 我會找個修繕師傅來修圍籬。
note: 小修找 handyman,大工程找 contractor

ex: The exterminator is coming Thursday to deal with the ants.
exzh: 除蟲業者星期四會來處理螞蟻。
note: 也常說 pest control

ex: Can you turn the thermostat up a couple of degrees?
exzh: 你可以把溫控器調高個兩度嗎?
note: 用華氏;68°F 約 20°C

ex: The furnace makes a weird noise every time it kicks on.
exzh: 暖氣爐每次啟動都會發出怪聲。
note: 中央暖氣;濾網要定期換

ex: Don't put rice or grease down the garbage disposal.
exzh: 不要把米飯或油倒進廚餘絞碎機。
note: 開關常在水槽旁牆上;手別伸進去

ex: Always lock the deadbolt before you go to bed.
exzh: 睡前一定要鎖上門閂鎖。

ex: The smoke detector keeps chirping, so I think the battery's dead.
exzh: 煙霧偵測器一直嗶嗶叫,應該是沒電了。
note: 隔一陣子嗶一聲=該換電池

ex: There's mold on the bathroom ceiling again.
exzh: 浴室天花板又長黴菌了。
note: 拍照並書面通報房東

ex: You can park in the driveway when you visit.
exzh: 你來的時候可以停在車道上。
note: 房子前通往車庫的私人車道

ex: Can I borrow your lawn mower this weekend?
exzh: 這週末可以借你的割草機嗎?

ex: The master bedroom has a huge walk-in closet.
exzh: 主臥有一個超大的走入式衣櫃。

ex: Most complexes require renter's insurance, but it's only about $15 a month.
exzh: 大多數社區要求租屋險,但一個月才15美元左右。
note: 保自己的財物;房東保險不含你的東西

ex: I filled out the rental application online last night.
exzh: 我昨晚在網路上填了租屋申請表。
note: 通常要付 application fee 約50美元

ex: There's a $50 fee for the credit check.
exzh: 信用調查要收50美元。
note: 沒分數可附在職證明和存款證明

ex: What move-in date are you looking for?
exzh: 你希望什麼時候入住?

ex: After the first year, the lease goes month-to-month.
exzh: 第一年過後,租約改成按月續租。
note: 較彈性,但租金通常較貴

ex: If you break the lease, you'll owe two months' rent.
exzh: 如果提前解約,你要付兩個月租金。
note: 先看租約的 early termination 條款

ex: I put in a maintenance request for the dishwasher.
exzh: 我送了洗碗機的報修單。
note: 多用線上 portal 送,留書面紀錄

ex: The AC is out again, and it's 95 degrees outside.
exzh: 冷氣又壞了,外面還有華氏95度。
note: out=壞掉;the power is out=停電

ex: The breaker tripped when I ran the microwave and the kettle at once.
exzh: 我同時開微波爐和熱水壺就跳電了。
note: 去 breaker box 把跳掉的開關扳回

ex: Trash day is Monday, and recycling is every other Thursday.
exzh: 週一收垃圾,回收是隔週四。
note: 前一晚把垃圾桶推到路邊(curb)

ex: Your package was left at the door at 2:14 p.m.
exzh: 你的包裹已於下午2:14放在門口。
note: 包裹常直接放門口,小心被偷

ex: It says signature required, so I need to be home tomorrow.
exzh: 上面寫須簽收,所以我明天得在家。
note: 不在家會留招領通知單

ex: You'll get a code for the package locker by email.
exzh: 你會收到包裹櫃的取件碼 email。

ex: You can pick up your keys at the leasing office.
exzh: 你可以到租賃辦公室領鑰匙。
note: 公寓社區的管理窗口

ex: Here you have to shovel the snow off your sidewalk within 24 hours.
exzh: 這裡下雪後24小時內要把門前人行道的雪鏟掉。
note: 門前人行道常是住戶責任,不鏟會罰

ex: I usually mow the lawn on Saturday mornings.
exzh: 我通常星期六早上割草。
note: 草太長 HOA 會寄警告信

ex: We decided to hire movers instead of renting a truck.
exzh: 我們決定請搬家公司,不自己租卡車。
note: 小費每人約20到40美元

ex: I need to set up internet before I start working from home.
exzh: 開始在家工作前我得先申辦網路。
note: 常要等技師,提前一兩週約

ex: The final walk-through is at 10 on Friday.
exzh: 退租驗屋在星期五十點。
note: 拍照錄影存證,押金爭議靠它

ex: The apartment has an in-unit washer and dryer, so no more laundromat.
exzh: 這間公寓屋內有洗衣機烘衣機,不用再跑自助洗衣店。
note: 租屋大加分;否則用公用洗衣房

en: Rent is due on the first.
ex: Rent is due on the first. After the fifth, there's a late fee.
exzh: 房租每月一號繳,過了五號會收滯納金。
note: 回:Can I set up autopay?

en: We'll need first and last month's rent.
zh: 要先付首月和末月租金
ex: We'll need first and last month's rent. The deposit is separate.
exzh: 我們需要首月和末月租金,押金另計。
note: 簽約時一次付清;回:Got it.

en: Mind if I come in and take a look?
ex: Mind if I come in and take a look? — Sure, come on in.
exzh: 介意我進去看一下嗎?——當然,請進。
note: 回:Sure, come on in.

en: Just submit a ticket through the portal.
ex: Just submit a ticket through the portal. We'll get someone out.
exzh: 上網站送個報修單就好,我們會派人過去。
note: 回:Okay, will do.

en: Your lease is up at the end of June.
ex: Your lease is up at the end of June. Are you planning to renew?
exzh: 你的租約六月底到期,打算續約嗎?
note: be up=到期;回:I'd like to renew.

en: The water will be shut off tomorrow morning.
ex: Heads up, the water will be shut off tomorrow morning. Sorry for the inconvenience.
exzh: 提醒一下,明天早上停水,造成不便很抱歉。
note: 回:Thanks for the heads-up.

ex: Hi! Did you just move in? — Yeah, last weekend. I'm in 3B.
exzh: 嗨!你剛搬來嗎?——對,上週末,我住3B。
note: 回:Yeah, last weekend.

ex: Is the deposit refundable? — Yes, as long as there's no damage.
exzh: 押金可以退嗎?——可以,只要沒有損壞。
note: 問清哪些費用不退(non-refundable)

en: Make sure your bins are out by 7 a.m.
zh: 七點前把垃圾桶推出去
ex: Pickup is early, so make sure your bins are out by 7 a.m.
exzh: 收垃圾很早,記得七點前把垃圾桶推出去。
note: bins=有輪大垃圾桶;回:Got it, thanks.

en: We'll send someone out between 8 and 12.
zh: 八點到十二點會派人去
ex: We'll send someone out between 8 and 12. — Do I need to be home?
exzh: 我們會在8點到12點間派人過去。——我需要在家嗎?
note: 回:Do I need to be home?

ex: Do you have any pets? There's a $300 pet deposit.
exzh: 你有養寵物嗎?寵物押金是300美元。
note: 回:No pets. / Just a cat.

ex: Excuse me, is that your car? You're blocking my driveway.
exzh: 不好意思,那是你的車嗎?你擋到我的車道了。
note: 回:Oh, sorry! I'll move it.

en: We'll deduct the cleaning fee from your deposit.
ex: If the carpet needs cleaning, we'll deduct the cleaning fee from your deposit.
exzh: 如果地毯需要清洗,清潔費會從押金扣。
note: 可要求扣款明細 (itemized list)

ex: Hi, the toilet keeps running. Could someone take a look?
exzh: 你好,馬桶水一直流,可以請人來看看嗎?
note: running=水箱一直進水,不是漏到地上

ex: Sorry to call so late, but the sink is backed up.
exzh: 抱歉這麼晚打來,但水槽堵住了。
note: backed up=堵住回水;也說 clogged

en: When's the earliest I can move in?
ex: I really like the place. When's the earliest I can move in?
exzh: 我很喜歡這裡,最快什麼時候能入住?

ex: The rent looks good. Is parking included?
exzh: 租金看起來不錯,有含停車位嗎?
note: 很多公寓停車另收月費

en: I'm locked out of my apartment.
ex: I'm locked out of my apartment. Is there anyone who can let me in?
exzh: 我被鎖在門外了,有人能幫我開門嗎?
note: let me in=幫我開門;可能收開鎖費

en: I'd like to renew my lease.
ex: I'd like to renew my lease. Is there any way to keep the same rent?
exzh: 我想續約,有沒有可能維持原租金?
note: 可以試著談不漲或少漲

en: Who do I call if something breaks?
ex: One more question: who do I call if something breaks?
exzh: 再問一個:東西壞了要找誰?
note: 常聽到:Just text me.

ex: You'll need your routing number to set up direct deposit.
exzh: 設定薪資直接入帳需要銀行代碼。
note: 9 碼,支票左下角或網銀可查

ex: The teller asked for my ID before cashing the check.
exzh: 櫃員在兌現支票前要求看我的證件。

ex: Please enter your PIN and press OK.
exzh: 請輸入密碼後按 OK。
note: 唸 pin;口語也常說 PIN number

ex: Sign up for autopay and get $5 off your monthly bill.
exzh: 申請自動扣款,每月帳單折5美元。
note: 電信、保險常給 autopay 折扣

ex: Your new statement is ready to view online.
exzh: 你的新月結單已可在線上查看。
note: 信用卡結帳後出 statement,再到期繳款

ex: Which carrier are you with? — T-Mobile.
exzh: 你用哪家電信?——T-Mobile。
note: 三大:Verizon、AT&T、T-Mobile

ex: I got a prepaid plan until I build some credit.
exzh: 在累積信用之前我先用預付方案。
note: 免信用審查,新來的人常用

ex: Is the unlimited plan really unlimited, or does it slow down?
exzh: 吃到飽方案真的無限嗎,還是會降速?
note: 常有降速門檻,要問清楚

ex: If the robot doesn't understand you, just keep saying representative.
exzh: 語音系統聽不懂的話,就一直說「專員」。
note: 一直說它,語音系統就會轉真人

ex: If you know your party's extension, you may dial it at any time.
exzh: 若知道對方分機,可隨時撥打。

ex: Your employer has to send your W-2 by January 31.
exzh: 雇主必須在1月31日前寄給你 W-2。
note: 報稅必備;唸 W two

ex: I did some freelance work last year, so I got a 1099.
exzh: 我去年接了些外包,所以收到1099。
note: 沒預扣稅,要自己繳

ex: You'll need to get this form notarized before you mail it.
exzh: 這份表格寄出前要先公證。
note: 銀行或 UPS 店常有公證人,帶證件

ex: The line at the DMV was out the door.
exzh: 監理所排隊排到門外。
note: 先上網預約可省好幾小時

ex: Can I open an account without an SSN?
exzh: 沒有社會安全號碼可以開戶嗎?
note: 口語常說 Social;只給必要的單位

ex: I spent all morning doing paperwork for the new job.
exzh: 我整個早上都在辦新工作的文書手續。
note: 不可數名詞

ex: How much postage do I need for this envelope?
exzh: 這個信封要貼多少郵資?

ex: The landlord only accepts a check or a money order.
exzh: 房東只收支票或匯票。
note: 郵局或超市可買,比寄現金安全

ex: You'll need a cashier's check for the down payment.
exzh: 頭期款需要用銀行本票。
note: 大額付款用,銀行保證兌付

ex: I rent a PO box because packages keep getting stolen.
exzh: 包裹一直被偷,所以我租了郵政信箱。
note: 有些單位不收 PO box 當住址

ex: Use your own bank's machine to avoid the ATM fee.
exzh: 用自己銀行的提款機就不用付手續費。
note: 跨行常兩邊都收,共3到5美元

ex: I'd like to open an account. Do I need an appointment?
exzh: 我想開戶,需要預約嗎?
note: 帶護照+地址證明;有的要 SSN

ex: If you only make the minimum payment, the interest adds up fast.
exzh: 如果只繳最低金額,利息會累積很快。
note: 只繳最低會被收高額利息

ex: I always pay in full, so I never pay interest.
exzh: 我都全額繳清,所以從沒付過利息。
note: 每月繳清=零利息又養信用

ex: Your account is past due. Please make a payment today.
exzh: 您的帳戶已逾期,請今天繳款。
note: 盡快繳,逾期30天會傷信用分數

ex: What kind of data plan do you have?
exzh: 你用的是什麼上網方案?

ex: If I switch carriers, can I keep my number?
exzh: 如果換電信公司,號碼可以保留嗎?
note: 可以,這叫 port your number

ex: I'd like to port my number from AT&T.
exzh: 我想把號碼從 AT&T 攜過來。
note: 需舊公司帳號和轉出 PIN

ex: For billing, press 1. For technical support, press 2.
exzh: 帳單問題請按1,技術支援請按2。
note: 按0或說 agent 常可轉真人

ex: I just want to talk to a real person, not a bot.
exzh: 我只想跟真人講話,不要機器人。

ex: Please fill out this form and bring it back to window 3.
exzh: 請填好這張表再拿回3號窗口。
note: fill out 整張表;fill in 填空格

ex: Sign here, and initial here and here.
exzh: 這裡簽名,這裡和這裡簽姓名縮寫。
note: initial=簽姓名縮寫

ex: For proof of address, a utility bill or your lease works.
exzh: 地址證明可以用水電帳單或租約。
note: 水電帳單、租約、銀行對帳單皆可

ex: I'll need to see a photo ID, please.
exzh: 麻煩給我看一下有照片的證件。
note: 駕照、州 ID、護照都算

ex: Take a number and have a seat. We'll call you.
exzh: 抽個號碼牌坐著等,會叫你。

ex: You're next in line, so it shouldn't be long.
exzh: 下一個就是你,應該不會太久。

ex: New residents usually have to get a state driver's license within 30 days.
exzh: 新居民通常要在30天內換發州駕照。
note: 各州規定不同,多半要筆試加路考

ex: Tax season starts in late January and ends in mid-April.
exzh: 報稅季從一月底開始,到四月中結束。
note: 截止日通常是 4/15

ex: Send it by certified mail so you have proof it arrived.
exzh: 用掛號寄,才有送達證明。
note: 重要文件寄出要留回執

ex: Can you send me the tracking number?
exzh: 可以把追蹤號碼傳給我嗎?

en: Can I put you on hold for a moment?
ex: Can I put you on hold for a moment? — Sure, no problem.
exzh: 可以請你稍候一下嗎?——好,沒問題。
note: 回:Sure, no problem.

en: I'm going to transfer you to the right department.
ex: I'm going to transfer you to the right department. Please stay on the line.
exzh: 我幫你轉接到相關部門,請不要掛斷。
note: 回:Okay. 先問回撥號碼以防斷線

en: Can you verify your date of birth?
ex: Before we get started, can you verify your date of birth?
exzh: 開始之前,可以請您核對出生日期嗎?
note: 回:Sure, March 5th, 1990.(月日年)

en: Is there anything else I can help you with?
zh: 還有其他需要幫忙的嗎
ex: Your refund has been processed. Is there anything else I can help you with?
exzh: 退款已處理好了,還有其他需要幫忙的嗎?
note: 回:No, that's it. Thanks!

en: Can I get the last four of your Social?
ex: For security purposes, can I get the last four of your Social?
exzh: 為了安全,可以告訴我社安號碼末四碼嗎?
note: Social=社會安全號碼;只念末四碼

en: This call may be recorded for quality assurance.
ex: Thank you for calling. This call may be recorded for quality assurance.
exzh: 感謝來電,本通話可能錄音以確保服務品質。
note: 幾乎每通客服電話開頭都有

en: Please listen carefully, as our menu options have changed.
ex: Thanks for calling. Please listen carefully, as our menu options have changed.
exzh: 感謝來電,我們的選單已更新,請仔細聆聽。
note: 語音系統老梗,通常沒變多少

ex: I can help whoever's next. — Hi, I'm here to renew my license.
exzh: 下一位請過來。——你好,我來換駕照。
note: 排隊時常聽到;輪到你就直接走過去

ex: Do you have an appointment? — No, I'm a walk-in.
exzh: 你有預約嗎?——沒有,我是現場來的。
note: 回:No, I'm a walk-in.

en: Do you have something with your address on it?
ex: Do you have something with your address on it? — I have my lease on my phone.
exzh: 有印著你地址的東西嗎?——我手機裡有租約。
note: 回:I have my lease on my phone.

en: Sign and date at the bottom.
ex: Okay, sign and date at the bottom. Then you're good to go.
exzh: 好,在最下面簽名並寫日期,這樣就可以了。
note: 日期寫法是 月/日/年

ex: Anything liquid, fragile, or perishable? — Nope, just books.
exzh: 裡面有液體、易碎或會壞的東西嗎?——沒有,只有書。
note: 郵局寄件必問;回:Nope, just books.

en: Your estimated wait time is 15 minutes.
ex: Your estimated wait time is 15 minutes. Press 1 to get a callback.
exzh: 預估等候時間15分鐘,按1可預約回電。
note: 選 callback 就不用一直拿著電話

en: I'd like to dispute a charge.
ex: Hi, I'd like to dispute a charge. I never made this purchase.
exzh: 你好,我想申訴一筆扣款,我沒買過這個。
note: dispute=對刷卡款提出異議

ex: Hi, I'm calling about my bill. It's a lot higher than usual.
exzh: 你好,我打來問帳單,這期比平常高很多。
note: 開頭先講來意,客服好轉對部門

en: Can I speak to a manager?
ex: I've explained this three times. Can I speak to a manager?
exzh: 我已經解釋三次了,可以找主管嗎?
note: 保持禮貌通常更有效

en: I'd like to cancel my service.
ex: I'd like to cancel my service. I'm moving out of state.
exzh: 我想取消服務,我要搬到外州。
note: 常被推挽留優惠,可順勢議價

ex: It's the first time I've been late. Can you waive the fee?
exzh: 這是我第一次遲繳,這筆費用可以免嗎?
note: 初犯常會答應,值得一問

ex: I never received my card. Can you send me a new one?
exzh: 我一直沒收到卡,可以補寄一張嗎?

en: What documents do I need to bring?
ex: What documents do I need to bring? — Your passport and proof of address.
exzh: 我需要帶哪些文件?——護照和地址證明。
note: DMV、銀行都先上網查清單

ex: The line was long, so I just used the self-checkout.
exzh: 排隊太長，所以我直接用自助結帳。
note: 買酒會卡住，要等店員來驗 ID

ex: You need a membership to shop at Costco.
exzh: 要有會員才能在 Costco 購物。
note: Costco 結帳先出示會員卡

ex: Please return your shopping cart to the cart corral.
exzh: 請把購物推車推回停放區。
note: 美國也常只說 cart

ex: The sale item is sold out, but we can give you a rain check.
exzh: 特價品賣完了，但可以給你一張補貨保價單。
note: 也指改天:Can I take a rain check?

ex: Target will price match Amazon if you show them the listing.
exzh: 只要給他們看網頁，Target 會比照 Amazon 的價格。
note: 各店規則不同，先問 Do you price match?

ex: Without a receipt, they can only give you store credit.
exzh: 沒有收據的話，他們只能給你購物金。
note: 沒收據退貨常見結果

ex: Can I do an exchange for a bigger size?
exzh: 我可以換大一號的嗎？
note: 退錢是 return，換東西是 exchange

ex: Chips are BOGO this week at Safeway.
exzh: Safeway 這週洋芋片買一送一。
note: 唸 BOH-go；也有 BOGO 50% off

ex: Can you grab half a pound of turkey from the deli?
exzh: 你可以去熟食櫃拿半磅火雞肉嗎？
note: 切肉片以磅計:thin sliced 切薄

ex: The avocados are in the produce section by the entrance.
exzh: 酪梨在入口旁的蔬果區。
note: 名詞重音在前:PRO-duce

ex: Let's just hit the drive-thru on the way home.
exzh: 回家路上直接去得來速吧。
note: 美式拼法 thru = through

ex: Each entree comes with two sides.
exzh: 每道主菜附兩樣配菜。
note: 美國 entree=主菜，法國是前菜

ex: Our server will be right over with the menus.
exzh: 我們的服務生馬上會拿菜單過來。
note: waiter/waitress 較少用，server 中性

ex: Do you want to make that a combo with fries and a drink?
exzh: 要不要改成附薯條和飲料的套餐？
note: 也說 meal:make it a meal

ex: I'll have the ribeye, medium rare, please.
exzh: 我要肋眼牛排，三分熟，謝謝。
note: 熟度:rare→medium→well-done

ex: Can I swap the milk for oat milk?
exzh: 牛奶可以換成燕麥奶嗎？
note: 換植物奶常加價 50–80 美分

ex: The barista called my name, but I didn't hear it.
exzh: 咖啡師叫了我的名字，但我沒聽到。
note: 點單常被問名字，可報好唸的英文名

ex: Could I get a to-go box for the rest of this?
exzh: 剩下的可以給我一個打包盒嗎？
note: 美國打包剩菜很正常，不失禮

ex: There's a two-dollar upcharge for avocado.
exzh: 加酪梨要多收兩美元。
note: 加料、換配菜常見 upcharge

ex: Your shopper is asking if a substitution is okay for the eggs.
exzh: 代購員在問雞蛋能不能換成替代品。
note: Instacart 常見，可設不替代

ex: The express checkout lane is for 15 items or less.
exzh: 快速結帳道限 15 件以下。
note: lane 3 is open 是叫你去 3 號

ex: Paper or plastic? — Paper's fine, thanks.
exzh: 紙袋還是塑膠袋？——紙袋就好，謝謝。
note: 很多州袋子要收 10 美分

ex: A medium drip, with room for cream, please.
exzh: 中杯美式滴濾，留點空間加奶，謝謝。
note: 店員會問 Room for cream?

ex: Are we doing separate checks or one check tonight?
exzh: 今晚要分開結還是一起結？
note: 點餐前先講最好，服務生好分單

ex: Can I get the Caesar salad with the dressing on the side?
exzh: 凱薩沙拉的醬可以另外放嗎？
note: 控制熱量常用

ex: No need to knock, just leave it at the door.
exzh: 不用敲門，放門口就好。
note: DoorDash 選 Leave at door 會拍照

ex: Large iced tea, light ice, please.
exzh: 大杯冰紅茶，少冰，謝謝。
note: 去冰說 no ice；美國預設冰很多

ex: Can you add an extra shot to my latte?
exzh: 我的拿鐵可以多加一份濃縮嗎？
note: 也說 add a shot

ex: I'll take the burger and a side of fries.
exzh: 我要漢堡加一份薯條。
note: side=配菜，可問 What are the sides?

ex: You can just tap to pay on the reader.
exzh: 你可以直接在機器上感應付款。
note: 手機 Apple Pay 也是 tap

ex: Tap didn't work? Go ahead and insert your chip.
exzh: 感應失敗？那請插入晶片。
note: 店員常說 Go ahead and insert

ex: Yogurt is buy one, get one free with your card.
exzh: 用會員卡優格買一送一。
note: 常縮寫為 BOGO

ex: Free tote bag with purchase, while supplies last.
exzh: 消費就送托特包，送完為止。
note: 廣告常見字

ex: I always order ahead on the app so I can skip the line.
exzh: 我都先用 App 點，這樣就不用排隊。
note: 取餐在 mobile pickup 架上

ex: I chose in-store pickup to avoid the shipping fee.
exzh: 我選店內取貨以免運費。
note: 取貨要報名字或出示訂單 QR

ex: Soda comes with free refills, so help yourself.
exzh: 汽水可以免費續杯，自己裝。
note: 美國汽水常無限續，咖啡不一定

ex: Two eggs over easy with bacon, please.
exzh: 兩顆兩面煎半熟蛋配培根，謝謝。
note: 另有 sunny side up、scrambled

ex: Hi, we're a party of four. Is there a wait?
exzh: 嗨，我們四位，要等嗎？
note: 帶位會問 How many in your party?

ex: I can ring you up over here.
exzh: 我可以在這邊幫你結帳。
note: 聽到就是叫你去那個櫃台結帳

ex: Returns must be in the original packaging with tags.
exzh: 退貨須保留原包裝和吊牌。
note: 退貨條件常見字

ex: Did you find everything okay? — Yep, all good, thanks.
exzh: 東西都找到了嗎？——有，都好，謝謝。
note: 結帳寒暄，回:Yes, thanks!

ex: Do you want your receipt? — No, I'm good.
exzh: 收據要嗎？——不用了。
note: 回:No, I'm good. 或 In the bag

en: Would you like to round up for charity?
ex: Would you like to round up for charity? — Not today, thanks.
exzh: 要湊整數捐給慈善嗎？——今天先不用，謝謝。
note: 拒絕很正常:Not today, thanks

ex: How is everything? — Great, thank you!
exzh: 餐點還好嗎？——很好，謝謝！
note: 嘴裡有食物點頭+thumbs up 即可

ex: Still working on that? — Yeah, I'm still working on it.
exzh: 還在吃嗎？——對，還在吃。
note: 想收盤子？回:No, I'm done/all set

en: Can I get you started with drinks?
ex: Can I get you started with drinks? — Just water for now.
exzh: 先點飲料嗎？——先給水就好。
note: 回:Just water for now. 水免費

en: Will that be all for you today?
ex: Will that be all for you today? — Yep, that's it.
exzh: 今天就這些嗎？——對，就這樣。
note: 回:That's it. / That'll do it

en: Do you have a rewards account with us?
ex: Do you have a rewards account with us? — Yeah, it's under my phone number.
exzh: 有我們的會員嗎？——有，用我的手機號碼。
note: 回:It's under my phone number

ex: What name for the order? — Kevin, K-E-V-I-N.
exzh: 訂單名字是？——Kevin，K-E-V-I-N。
note: 取餐靠名字，可順便拼出來

en: Is this for here or to go?
ex: Is this for here or to go? — For here, please.
exzh: 內用還是外帶？——內用，謝謝。
note: 回:For here. / To go.

en: Do you want any sauce with that?
ex: Do you want any sauce with that? — Can I get ranch?
exzh: 要附醬嗎？——可以給我田園醬嗎？
note: 速食店醬包常要開口要

en: How would you like that cooked?
ex: How would you like that cooked? — Medium, please.
exzh: 要幾分熟？——五分熟，謝謝。
note: 漢堡也會問；回熟度即可

ex: Do you have the receipt? — No, but I paid with this card.
exzh: 有收據嗎？——沒有，但我是刷這張卡。
note: 退貨必問；刷卡可用卡查紀錄

en: Can I get a large iced latte with oat milk?
ex: Hi, can I get a large iced latte with oat milk? — Sure, what name?
exzh: 嗨，我要大杯冰燕麥拿鐵。——好，名字是？
note: 點餐用 Can I get... 最自然

ex: Before we order, could we get separate checks?
exzh: 點餐前先問，可以分開結帳嗎？
note: 也可說 split it by card

ex: Hi, I'd like to return this. It doesn't fit.
exzh: 嗨，我想退這個，尺寸不合。
note: 去 Customer Service 櫃台說

ex: Walmart has it for $5 less. Do you price match?
exzh: Walmart 便宜 5 美元，你們有比價退差嗎？
note: 拿手機秀別家價格

en: Do you have any more of these in the back?
ex: The shelf is empty. Do you have any more of these in the back?
exzh: 架上空了，後面倉庫還有嗎？
note: in the back=後場倉庫

en: I think I was charged twice.
ex: Sorry, I think I was charged twice. The milk shows up two times.
exzh: 不好意思，我好像被扣了兩次，牛奶出現兩次。
note: 對帳單也可說 double-charged

en: Can I get a box for this?
ex: I couldn't finish it. Can I get a box for this?
exzh: 我吃不完，可以給我打包盒嗎？
note: 服務生也會問 Need a box?

ex: My monthly premium went up again this year.
exzh: 今年我的月保費又漲了。
note: 每月固定繳，不管有沒有看病

ex: Make sure the doctor is in-network before you book.
exzh: 預約前先確認醫生在保險網內。
note: 網內便宜很多，先上保險 App 查

ex: That lab was out-of-network, so I got a huge bill.
exzh: 那家檢驗所在網外，所以收到天價帳單。
note: 網外可能幾乎不給付

ex: You need to pick a PCP when you sign up for the plan.
exzh: 投保時要選一位家庭主治醫師。
note: primary care physician；HMO 必選

ex: The EOB says it's not a bill, so don't pay it yet.
exzh: EOB 上寫這不是帳單，所以先別付。
note: Explanation of Benefits，跟帳單對

ex: The MRI needs prior authorization from your insurance.
exzh: 做 MRI 需要保險公司事前核准。
note: 常簡稱 prior auth，診所會代申請

ex: Open enrollment ends Friday, so pick your plan now.
exzh: 年度投保期週五截止，現在就選方案。
note: 多在 11 月；錯過要等明年

ex: After the deductible, my coinsurance is 20 percent.
exzh: 自付額扣完後，我的共保自付是兩成。
note: copay 固定金額；coinsurance 是 %

ex: My PCP referred me to a specialist for my knee.
exzh: 家醫把我的膝蓋轉介給專科醫師。
note: 專科 copay 通常比家醫高

ex: I have my annual physical next Tuesday.
exzh: 我下週二做年度健檢。
note: 多數保險一年一次免費

ex: The generic is way cheaper and works the same.
exzh: 學名藥便宜很多，效果一樣。
note: 藥局預設給 generic

ex: My insurance won't cover the brand-name version.
exzh: 我的保險不給付原廠版本。
note: 原廠藥 copay 較貴

ex: Good news, no cavity this time!
exzh: 好消息，這次沒有蛀牙！
note: 複數 cavities

ex: I need a filling on my back tooth.
exzh: 我後面一顆牙需要補。
note: 牙醫保險常只付部分

ex: We'll take an X-ray to make sure nothing's broken.
exzh: 我們照個 X 光確認沒骨折。
note: 唸 EX-ray

ex: If you can't breathe, go straight to the ER.
exzh: 如果呼吸困難，直接去急診。
note: ER 貴；不危急先去 urgent care

ex: The nurse will check your vitals first.
exzh: 護理師會先量你的生命徵象。
note: 血壓、心跳、體溫、血氧

ex: They did a quick swab and it was strep throat.
exzh: 他們快篩一下，結果是鏈球菌喉炎。
note: 美國很常見，常簡稱 strep

ex: He cut his hand and needed five stitches.
exzh: 他割傷手，縫了五針。
note: 拆線:get my stitches out

ex: I pay for my glasses with my HSA card.
exzh: 我用健康儲蓄帳戶的卡付眼鏡錢。
note: 免稅存醫療錢；FSA 年底會歸零

ex: Once you hit your out-of-pocket max, insurance pays 100%.
exzh: 達到年度自付上限後，保險全額給付。
note: 選方案時最該看的數字

ex: I've got a stuffy nose and can't sleep.
exzh: 我鼻塞睡不著。
note: 也說 I'm all stuffed up

ex: She's been sick all night and can't keep food down.
exzh: 她整晚不舒服，吃什麼都吐。
note: 醫生問 Can you keep fluids down?

ex: I need to stop by CVS to pick up a prescription.
exzh: 我要順路去 CVS 領處方藥。
note: 醫生電子傳到你指定的藥局

ex: It takes about an hour to fill a prescription here.
exzh: 這裡配一張處方大約要一小時。
note: 藥局說 It's being filled=配藥中

ex: My son's running a fever, so he's staying home.
exzh: 我兒子在發燒，所以待在家。
note: 美國用華氏:100.4°F 算發燒

ex: I'm due for a teeth cleaning next month.
exzh: 我下個月該洗牙了。
note: 牙醫保險多含一年兩次

ex: I think this cold turned into a sinus infection.
exzh: 我覺得這感冒變成鼻竇炎了。
note: 美國人很常說，不一定給抗生素

ex: You look awful. Just take a sick day.
exzh: 你氣色很差，請一天病假吧。
note: 美國生病來上班反而被嫌

ex: I feel lightheaded when I stand up too fast.
exzh: 我站太快就會頭暈眼花。
note: 比 dizzy 輕，像快暈倒

ex: Let's schedule a follow-up appointment in two weeks.
exzh: 兩週後安排回診吧。
note: 也簡稱 a follow-up

ex: I get a sharp pain here when I breathe in.
exzh: 我吸氣時這裡會刺痛。
note: 醫生會問 sharp or dull?

ex: It's more of a dull ache than a sharp pain.
exzh: 比較像悶痛，不是刺痛。
note: 另有 throbbing 抽痛

ex: I woke up with a scratchy throat this morning.
exzh: 我今天早上醒來喉嚨癢癢刺刺的。
note: 感冒初期最常說

ex: Call 911 if you're short of breath or have chest pain.
exzh: 如果呼吸急促或胸痛，打 911。
note: 醫療用語；危險徵兆

ex: Half the office is out with a stomach bug.
exzh: 辦公室一半的人得腸胃炎請假。
note: 口語說法，上吐下瀉

ex: Please come 15 minutes early to fill out paperwork.
exzh: 請提早 15 分鐘到，填寫資料表。
note: 現多在 patient portal 線上填

ex: Dr. Lee isn't taking any new patient appointments until March.
exzh: 李醫師三月前不收初診病人。
note: 問:Accepting new patients?

ex: I have to fast tonight to get bloodwork done tomorrow.
exzh: 明天抽血，今晚要禁食。
note: fasting=空腹，通常 8–12 小時

ex: He passed out, so we had to call 911.
exzh: 他昏倒了，所以我們打了 911。
note: 唸 nine-one-one；救護車要收費

ex: What brings you in today? — I've had a cough for about a week.
exzh: 今天來看什麼？——我咳嗽大概一週了。
note: 回:I've had... for (時間)

ex: Do you have any allergies? — Just penicillin.
exzh: 有任何過敏嗎？——只有盤尼西林。
note: 回:None that I know of

en: On a scale of 1 to 10, how bad is the pain?
ex: On a scale of 1 to 10, how bad is the pain? — Maybe a 6.
exzh: 1 到 10 分，痛有多嚴重？——大概 6 分。
note: 回數字即可:about a 6

en: Go ahead and step on the scale.
ex: Go ahead and step on the scale. You can leave your shoes on.
exzh: 請站上體重計，鞋子可以不用脫。
note: 美國用磅；Go ahead and=請

ex: Are you on any medications? — Just a daily allergy pill.
exzh: 有在吃藥嗎？——只有每天一顆過敏藥。
note: 回:No / Just vitamins

en: Can I get your date of birth?
ex: Pickup for Chen? Can I get your date of birth?
exzh: 陳先生領藥？請問你的出生日期？
note: 美式:月/日/年 May 3rd, 1990

en: Is this your first time taking it?
ex: Is this your first time taking it? — Yes. — Okay, the pharmacist will talk to you.
exzh: 第一次吃這藥嗎？——對。——好，藥師會跟你說明。
note: 說 yes 藥師會解說；可說 No, refill

en: Do you have any questions for the pharmacist?
ex: Do you have any questions for the pharmacist? — No, I'm good.
exzh: 有要問藥師的嗎？——沒有，不用了。
note: 領藥簽名前必問

en: Can I see your insurance card and ID?
ex: Hi, checking in? Can I see your insurance card and ID?
exzh: 嗨，報到嗎？請給我保險卡和證件。
note: 櫃台第一句，卡隨身帶

ex: Have you been here before? — No, it's my first visit.
exzh: 以前來過嗎？——沒有，第一次。
note: 沒來過要填初診資料

en: The doctor will be right with you.
ex: Go ahead and change into the gown. The doctor will be right with you.
exzh: 請換上病人服，醫生馬上來。
note: 通常還要等 10–20 分鐘

en: Is your address still the same?
ex: Is your address still the same? — Yes, nothing's changed.
exzh: 地址還一樣嗎？——對，沒變。
note: 回:Yep, same.

en: You have a small cavity, so we'll need to do a filling.
ex: Your gums look good. You have a small cavity, so we'll need to do a filling.
exzh: 牙齦不錯，但有個小蛀牙，要補。
note: 可問:How much will that cost?

en: I'd like to make an appointment.
ex: Hi, I'd like to make an appointment. Does Dr. Patel have anything this week?
exzh: 嗨，我想預約看診。Patel 醫師這週有空檔嗎？
note: 會問 What's it for? 簡述症狀

en: Is this covered by my insurance?
ex: Before we do the test, is this covered by my insurance?
exzh: 做檢查前先問，我的保險有給付嗎？
note: 事前問可避免驚嚇帳單

ex: That's pretty expensive. Is there a generic version?
exzh: 那有點貴，有學名藥版本嗎？
note: 也可問有沒有 GoodRx 折價

ex: I twisted my ankle. It's really swollen now.
exzh: 我扭到腳踝，現在腫得很厲害。
note: 較嚴重可說 sprained

en: I've had a fever since yesterday.
ex: I've had a fever since yesterday. It hit 101 last night.
exzh: 我從昨天開始發燒，昨晚到華氏 101 度。

en: I'm not going to make it in today.
ex: Hey, I'm not going to make it in today. I've got a stomach bug.
exzh: 嘿，我今天沒辦法進公司，得了腸胃炎。
note: Slack 訊息請病假的口語說法

en: Is my prescription ready for pickup?
ex: Hi, is my prescription ready for pickup? Last name Chen.
exzh: 嗨，我的藥可以領了嗎？姓陳。
note: App 會傳簡訊通知 ready

ex: Take the freeway if you want to get there in under an hour.
exzh: 想一小時內到就走高速公路。
note: 西岸說 freeway,東岸常說 highway

ex: The on-ramp is closed, so use the next one.
exzh: 那個上匝道封了,走下一個。
note: 下高速的匝道叫 off-ramp

ex: Stop tailgating him, you're way too close.
exzh: 別再跟他那麼近,太近了。
note: 另一義:球賽前停車場烤肉派對

ex: He never uses his blinker when he changes lanes.
exzh: 他換車道從來不打方向燈。
note: 口語說 blinker,正式是 turn signal

ex: You need two people in the car to use the carpool lane.
exzh: 車上要兩人以上才能開共乘車道。
note: 又叫 HOV lane;單人開會被罰

ex: At a four-way stop, whoever stops first goes first.
exzh: 四向停車路口先停的先走。
note: 同時到時右邊的車先行

ex: You can't make a U-turn here, there's a sign.
exzh: 這裡不能迴轉,有標誌。
note: make a U-turn / flip a U(口語)

ex: Slow down, it's a school zone and kids are getting out.
exzh: 慢一點,這是學區,小孩正在放學。
note: 常限速 15–25 mph,罰款加倍

ex: I got a speeding ticket on my way to work today.
exzh: 我今天上班途中吃了超速罰單。
note: 會讓保費上漲;可上交通課抵點

ex: My registration expires next month, I need to renew it at the DMV.
exzh: 我的行照下個月到期,要去 DMV 換。
note: 車籍每年要續,放手套箱

ex: Do you know a good mechanic who won't rip me off?
exzh: 你知道哪個不會坑人的修車師傅嗎?
note: 找修車廠最好問鄰居推薦

ex: The restaurant only has valet, it's twelve bucks.
exzh: 那家餐廳只有代客泊車,12 美元。
note: 念 va-LAY;取車時給小費 $2–5

ex: Park in the garage? — Yeah, the parking garage on 5th is cheaper.
exzh: 停室內嗎?——對,第五街那個停車場較便宜。
note: 記得拍樓層號碼;常要先拿票

ex: There's a rideshare pickup area on the second level.
exzh: 二樓有叫車服務的上車區。
note: 機場都有指定 rideshare 上車區

ex: Don't turn there, it's a dead end.
exzh: 別轉那裡,那是死路。
note: 黃色 DEAD END 牌=不通

ex: You can turn right on red here unless there's a sign saying no.
exzh: 這裡紅燈可右轉,除非有禁止標誌。
note: 必須先完全停車;紐約市禁止

ex: You have to yield to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
exzh: 斑馬線上要禮讓行人。
note: 倒三角 YIELD 牌=讓路

ex: I got pulled over for a broken taillight.
exzh: 我因為尾燈壞了被警察攔下。
note: 被攔留車上、手放方向盤

ex: Just fill it up, I'm going on a road trip.
exzh: 加滿就好,我要公路旅行。
note: 美國多自助;NJ 才有人幫你加

ex: The card reader's broken, you'll have to pay inside.
exzh: 讀卡機壞了,要進店裡付。
note: 付現要先付,說 $40 on pump 3

ex: My car's fine with regular gas, no need for premium.
exzh: 我的車加一般汽油就好,不用高級。
note: 87 regular/89 mid/91+ premium

ex: What's your pump number? — Pump six.
exzh: 你是幾號加油機?——六號。
note: 進店付款要先說機號

ex: Don't park there, it's a tow-away zone after 4 p.m.
exzh: 別停那,下午四點後是拖吊區。
note: 被拖要去 impound lot 付錢領車

ex: That street is permit only, you'll get a ticket.
exzh: 那條街只限有證的停,會被開單。
note: 住宅區常見 Residential permit

ex: I need to go feed the meter before I get a ticket.
exzh: 我得去投停車錶,免得吃罰單。
note: 現在多用 ParkMobile 等 app 付

ex: My check engine light is on. Should I be worried?
exzh: 我的引擎燈亮了,要擔心嗎?
note: AutoZone 等可免費讀故障碼

ex: I got a flat on the freeway and had to call AAA.
exzh: 我在高速公路爆胎,只好叫 AAA。
note: AAA=道路救援會員,很多人有

ex: I'm taking the car in for an oil change on Saturday.
exzh: 我週六要把車送去換機油。
note: 常順便被推銷換濾網,可拒絕

ex: My car's in the shop, can you give me a ride?
exzh: 我車子送修了,可以載我嗎?
note: the shop=修車廠

ex: Careful, there's a red-light camera at that intersection.
exzh: 小心,那個路口有闖紅燈照相。
note: 罰單會寄到家,約 $100–500

ex: It was bumper-to-bumper all the way home.
exzh: 回家一路車接車塞死。
note: 聊通勤最常用的形容

ex: The pharmacy is two blocks down on the right.
exzh: 藥局往前兩個街口在右邊。
note: block=兩路口間的一段

ex: Go past the light and it'll be on your left.
exzh: 過紅綠燈後就在你左手邊。
note: 騎車/跑步超車也會喊這句

ex: Take the next exit and turn left at the light.
exzh: 下一個出口下去,紅綠燈左轉。
note: 美國出口用里程編號,如 Exit 42

ex: If your car is financed, you'll need full coverage.
exzh: 車子有貸款的話必須保全險。
note: liability 只賠對方;新移民保費高

ex: Evening. License and registration, please.
exzh: 晚安。請出示駕照和行照。
note: 先說要伸手拿,動作慢;回:Sure.

en: Do you know why I pulled you over?
ex: Do you know why I pulled you over? — No, officer.
exzh: 知道我為何攔你嗎?——不知道,警官。
note: 別自己認罪;回 No, officer 即可

en: Do you know how fast you were going?
ex: Do you know how fast you were going? — I'm not sure, sorry.
exzh: 知道你剛開多快嗎?——不太確定,抱歉。
note: 警察開場套話,保持禮貌簡短

en: I'm going to let you off with a warning.
ex: I'm going to let you off with a warning. Just slow down.
exzh: 這次只給你警告,開慢點。
note: =不開單;回:Thank you, officer.

en: Do you have proof of insurance?
ex: Do you have proof of insurance? — Yes, it's on my phone.
exzh: 有保險證明嗎?——有,在我手機裡。
note: 多數州接受手機上的保險卡

ex: Which pump are you on? — Number four, forty on it.
exzh: 你在幾號機?——四號,先加 40。
note: 回:Pump 4, $40 on it.

en: It'll be ready by end of day.
ex: We're waiting on a part. It'll be ready by end of day.
exzh: 在等零件,但今天傍晚前會好。
note: 回:Great, text me when done.

en: You're due for an oil change.
ex: Looks like you're due for an oil change.
exzh: 看起來你快該換機油了。
note: due for=到期該做了

en: Your brake pads are pretty worn.
ex: Your brake pads are pretty worn. Want us to replace them?
exzh: 煞車皮磨很多了,要幫你換嗎?
note: 可回:Can I get a quote first?

en: We'll call you when it's ready.
ex: Leave your keys with us and we'll call you when it's ready.
exzh: 鑰匙留下,好了會打電話給你。
note: 修車、乾洗、取件都這樣說

ex: Your driver is arriving. Look for a gray Camry.
exzh: 司機快到了,找一台灰色 Camry。
note: 上車前核對車牌再上

ex: Who am I picking up? — Kevin, going to the airport.
exzh: 我來接哪位?——Kevin,去機場。
note: 司機確認乘客;別先報名字給陌生車

ex: It's the big red building on the corner. You can't miss it.
exzh: 轉角那棟紅色大樓,一定看得到。
note: 報路結尾慣用語

ex: Is it far? — It's about a twenty-minute drive.
exzh: 遠嗎?——開車大約二十分鐘。
note: 美國人用時間不用里程說距離

ex: Ugh, traffic's backed up on the 405. Take surface streets.
exzh: 405 塞了,走平面道路吧。
note: 加州習慣在公路號前加 the

ex: Tires are all set. You're good to go.
exzh: 輪胎都弄好了,可以走了。
note: =手續完成;回:Awesome, thanks!

en: Can you take a look at my car?
ex: It's making a weird noise. Can you take a look at my car?
exzh: 它有怪聲,能幫我看一下車嗎?
note: 描述症狀:noise/shaking/leaking

en: How much is that going to run me?
ex: New tires? How much is that going to run me?
exzh: 換新輪胎?大概要多少錢?
note: run me=花我…;很道地的問價

en: You can drop me off right here.
ex: Thanks! You can drop me off right here.
exzh: 這裡讓我下車就好,謝謝!
note: Uber 下車常用;小費在 app 給

en: Is it okay to park here?
ex: Excuse me, is it okay to park here?
exzh: 請問這裡可以停過夜嗎?
note: 看路緣顏色:紅禁停、綠限時

ex: Excuse me, does this bus go downtown?
exzh: 請問這班公車有到市中心嗎?
note: 上車問司機;多數要從前門上

ex: To get to the stadium, do I need to transfer?
exzh: 去球場的話需要轉車嗎?
note: 刷卡多在時限內免費轉乘

en: I think I have a flat tire.
ex: Hi, I think I have a flat tire. Can you send someone?
exzh: 你好,我好像爆胎了,能派人來嗎?
note: 打給 AAA 或保險的道路救援

en: I'm running a few minutes late.
ex: Hey, sorry! I'm running a few minutes late.
exzh: 嘿,我會晚幾分鐘,交通超塞。
note: 遲到前先傳訊是基本禮貌

en: Can I get a quote first?
ex: Before you do any work, can I get a quote first?
exzh: 動工前,可以先給我報價嗎?
note: 修車、裝潢都先要 quote 防被坑

ex: We're hosting Friendsgiving this year, you in?
exzh: 今年我們辦朋友感恩節聚餐,來嗎?
note: 沒回老家的人互相聚,常 potluck

ex: We're having a cookout on the Fourth, come on over!
exzh: 國慶日我們烤肉,過來玩!
note: =BBQ party;可帶飲料或配菜

ex: The office potluck is Friday, I'm bringing dumplings.
exzh: 公司週五聚餐每人帶菜,我帶餃子。
note: 帶家鄉菜很受歡迎

ex: They invited us to their housewarming on Saturday.
exzh: 他們邀我們週六去喬遷派對。
note: 帶瓶酒、植物或小禮物即可

ex: Jen's baby shower is next weekend, did you get a gift?
exzh: Jen 的迎嬰派對在下週末,買禮物了嗎?
note: 照 registry 清單買禮物

ex: Would Emma like to come over for a playdate?
exzh: Emma 想來我們家玩嗎?
note: 家長間約;常互換電話

ex: The PTA is looking for volunteers for the book fair.
exzh: 家長會在找書展志工。
note: Parent-Teacher Association

ex: Drop-off is crazy, I always get there by 7:50.
exzh: 送小孩時段超亂,我都 7:50 前到。
note: 接小孩時段叫 pickup

ex: Don't forget to sign the field trip form tonight.
exzh: 今晚別忘了簽校外教學同意書。
note: 常徵家長 chaperone 陪同

zh: 超級盃(美式足球冠軍賽)
ex: Are you going to Mike's for the Super Bowl?
exzh: 你要去 Mike 家看超級盃嗎?
note: 2 月初週日;看廣告也是重點

ex: They need one more chaperone for the zoo trip.
exzh: 動物園校外教學還缺一位隨隊家長。
note: 念 SHAP-er-own;常需背景審查

ex: It's BYOB, so grab a six-pack on your way.
exzh: 要自備酒水,路上帶一手啤酒。
note: Bring Your Own Beer/Bottle

ex: Our street is having a block party this Saturday.
exzh: 我們這條街週六辦街坊派對。
note: 認識鄰居的好機會

ex: Asking about their dog is a great icebreaker.
exzh: 問對方的狗是很好的破冰話題。
note: 寵物、小孩、球隊最好聊

ex: We're going to tailgate before the game, want to come?
exzh: 我們球賽前要在停車場烤肉,要來嗎?
note: 大學美足文化;帶烤架和啤酒

ex: What's up? — Not much, you?
exzh: 最近怎樣?——沒什麼,你呢?
note: 回 What's up 的標準答案

ex: How's it going? — Can't complain. You?
exzh: 最近好嗎?——還不錯,你呢?
note: =沒什麼好抱怨,算好

ex: Anything new? — Same old, same old.
exzh: 有什麼新鮮事?——老樣子。
note: 生活沒變化時的萬用回答

ex: We just got back from Hawaii. — Oh nice! How was it?
exzh: 我們剛從夏威夷回來。——不錯耶!好玩嗎?
note: 接著追問一句,話題就延續

ex: It's 105 degrees today. — No kidding. I'm melting.
exzh: 今天 105 度。——可不是嘛,熱化了。
note: 可表驚訝,也可表「當然」

ex: Mondays are brutal. — I hear you.
exzh: 週一好難熬。——我懂。
note: 表同理,不一定代表同意

ex: We're moving to Seattle next month. — Oh, that's exciting!
exzh: 我們下月搬去西雅圖。——哇,好期待!
note: 對方分享新計畫時的回應

ex: My flight got canceled again. — Ugh, that's the worst.
exzh: 我班機又被取消。——唉,太慘了。
note: 小倒楣事的同情回應

ex: Anyway, I'll let you go. Have a good night!
exzh: 好啦,不耽誤你了,晚安!
note: 禮貌結束對話/電話的信號

ex: Bye, Tom! Good seeing you. Say hi to Sarah!
exzh: 很高興見到你,幫我跟 Sarah 問好!
note: 道別用;初次見面才用 meet

ex: Everyone's supposed to bring a dish to share.
exzh: 每個人都要帶一道菜來分享。
note: 先問主人缺甜點還是配菜

ex: Pickleball Sunday? Count me in.
exzh: 週日打匹克球?算我一個。
note: 反義:Count me out.

ex: Thanks so much, but I'll have to pass.
exzh: 謝謝,不過這次我就不去了。
note: 婉拒不必給詳細理由

ex: Can I take a rain check? I'm wiped out tonight.
exzh: 可以改天嗎?我今晚累垮了。
note: 真的想去才用;否則就是婉拒

ex: My daughter made the soccer team. — That's so cool!
exzh: 我女兒進了足球隊。——好棒!
note: 美國人稱讚門檻低,常用

ex: Thanks for your help. Have a good one.
exzh: 謝謝幫忙,祝你順心!
note: 任何時段都能用的道別

ex: You went to Purdue too? Small world!
exzh: 你也念普渡?世界真小!
note: 發現共同點時說

ex: This heat is unreal. — Tell me about it. My AC is dying.
exzh: 這熱度太誇張。——可不是嘛,我冷氣快掛了。
note: 不是要你說,是強烈同意

ex: Have a great weekend! — Thanks, you too!
exzh: 週末愉快!——謝謝,你也是!
note: 服務生說 Enjoy 時回這句也常見

ex: How's your mom doing? — Much better, thanks for asking.
exzh: 你媽還好嗎?——好多了,謝謝關心。
note: 別人問候近況時的禮貌回應

ex: Hey! How's your week going? — Pretty good, kind of busy.
exzh: 嘿!這週怎樣?——還不錯,有點忙。
note: 回:Pretty good! Yours?

ex: Doing anything fun this weekend? — Just yard work, you?
exzh: 週末有要玩什麼嗎?——整理院子,你呢?
note: 週四、週五同事必問;回答再反問

en: Got any big plans for Thanksgiving?
ex: Got any big plans for Thanksgiving? — Just family, you?
exzh: 感恩節有大計畫嗎?——就家人,你呢?
note: 十一月必聊;沒處去常會被邀

en: Are you watching the game tonight?
ex: Are you watching the game tonight? — Wouldn't miss it!
exzh: 今晚看比賽嗎?——當然不會錯過!
note: 不懂球可回:Who's playing?

ex: Crazy weather we're having, huh? — Ugh, I know!
exzh: 最近天氣好怪齁?——可不是嘛!
note: 純開場;回 Tell me about it 即可

ex: It was fun running into you! We should hang out sometime.
exzh: 巧遇真開心!改天出來玩吧。
note: 多半是客套;真要約請給日期

ex: Great chatting! Let's grab coffee sometime.
exzh: 聊得真愉快!改天喝咖啡吧。
note: 常是道別客套;回:For sure!

ex: Can I bring anything? — Nope, just bring yourself!
exzh: 要帶什麼嗎?——不用,人來就好!
note: 仍可帶瓶酒或甜點表心意

ex: We're doing a Friendsgiving. You should totally come!
exzh: 我們辦朋友感恩節,你一定要來!
note: 有時間地點=真心邀請

en: Feel free to bring the kids.
ex: It's super casual, feel free to bring the kids.
exzh: 很隨性,歡迎帶小孩來。
note: 沒說就先問 Are kids welcome?

en: How are you liking it here?
ex: So you just moved from Taiwan? How are you liking it here?
exzh: 剛從台灣搬來?住得習慣嗎?
note: 回:I love it! Still adjusting.

ex: Where are you from originally? — Taiwan, Taipei.
exzh: 你原本是哪裡人?——台灣台北。
note: originally 讓問題較不冒犯

en: Let me know if you need anything.
ex: Welcome to the team! Let me know if you need anything.
exzh: 歡迎加入!有需要儘管說。
note: 客氣話,但真的開口通常會幫

ex: I love your jacket! — Thanks! I got it on sale at Costco.
exzh: 外套好好看!——謝啦!Costco 特價買的。
note: 回 Thanks 就好,別說「哪有」

ex: Oh my gosh, it's been forever! How are you?
exzh: 天啊,超久不見!你好嗎?
note: 回:I know! How have you been?

ex: Hi, I'm Linda next door. Welcome to the neighborhood!
exzh: 嗨,我是隔壁的 Linda,歡迎搬來!
note: 回:Thanks! We just moved in.

ex: Thanks for inviting us! Can I bring anything?
exzh: 謝謝邀請!需要我帶什麼嗎?
note: 受邀必問的一句

ex: Sounds fun! I'll try to make it.
exzh: 聽起來好玩!我盡量去。
note: 美國人說這句常=大概不會去

en: I'd love to, but I already have plans.
ex: Saturday? I'd love to, but I already have plans.
exzh: 週六?很想去,但我已經有約。
note: 可補:Maybe next time?

ex: Thanks for the invite! We'll definitely be there.
exzh: 謝謝邀請!我們一定到。
note: invite 當名詞是口語

en: We just moved here from Taiwan.
ex: Hi, I'm Alex. We just moved here from Taiwan.
exzh: 嗨,我是 Alex,我們剛從台灣搬來。
note: 自我介紹後對方多會熱心推薦

en: How long have you lived here?
ex: How long have you lived here? — About ten years.
exzh: 你住這多久了?——大概十年。
note: 接著問推薦餐廳/醫生很自然

en: Which teacher does your son have?
ex: Which teacher does your son have? Mine has Mrs. Lopez.
exzh: 你兒子是哪個老師?我家是 Lopez 老師。
note: 接送時和家長聊天的開場

ex: Anyway, I should get going. Great to see you!
exzh: 好啦,我該走了,很高興見到你!
note: anyway 是結束話題的信號

ex: Congrats on the new baby! How are you guys holding up?
exzh: 恭喜添寶寶!你們還撐得住嗎?
note: 也可說 Congrats on the new job!
